scope: Freeze concrete integration API before code. No implementation or execution. Original source/proof/relation requirements and telemetry persistence unchanged.
preview_signature: preview(pkg, source, relation_bytes, proof=None, obligations=None, *, readable_selection: bytes | None = None, select_readable: bool = False) -> tuple[GoalSpec, Build, dict]
preview_modes: readable_selection is None and select_readable=False: strict legacy BASE behavior; original callers and .1 backend remain unaffected; no implicit support selection or new sidecar.

readable_selection is None and select_readable=True: explicit first source preview only (proof must be None). Admit unchanged BASE, try isolated optional enrichment, freeze CHECKED or unavailable BASE selection before any proof authoring. Return exact selection bytes; all later calls replay them.

readable_selection is bytes: schema/hash validate and replay exact frozen mode and checked descriptor, never attempt a new optional selection. select_readable must be False. Any byte mutation/mismatched source/profile/relation/renderer/base goal is rejected. Frozen CHECKED failure cannot fallback.
No empty-byte sentinel or author-controlled executable readable body. .1 rejects/does not receive readable arguments; agent dispatch supplies these options only for .3.

preview_info_keys.existing: Preserve current proposition_hash, obligations, required_obligations, symbols, proof_checked, edge_axioms, model, profile and optional compile_process_evidence unchanged.
preview_info_keys.readable_selection: Exact canonical bytes or None. Present with bytes after explicit selection/replay; do not embed bytes directly in JSON records.
preview_info_keys.readable_source_view: JSON-serializable bounded authoring packet: version, selected_mode, status, selection_hash, source_hash, source_key, base_goal_hash, selected_goal_hash, renderer descriptor, exact helper/entry equality inventory/ref names and bound artifact references; unavailable reasons/full diagnostic refs. No authority beyond current checked preview.
preview_info_keys.readable_artifacts: dict[str, bytes] of durable source/IR/correspondence/export/inventory/diagnostic preview files under fixed relative readable/ paths, plus support/readable/selection.json bytes. Agents retain files once. Only exact selection and its declared diagnostic input files are candidate metadata inputs; accepted support code is always regenerated, never read as supplied code.
preview_info_keys.readable_candidate_artifacts: dict[str, bytes] containing exactly support/readable/selection.json and closed selection.diagnostic_inputs artifact paths/bytes; used for returned candidate and candidate_files. Checked code artifacts are not candidate-supplied executable input.

goal_context_build_fields.EdgeContext.readable_selection: bytes | None, loaded from one exact role/slot/path of target node; separate from unchanged five ctx.inputs. Also retain bound diagnostic input bytes with reader recheck.
goal_context_build_fields.GoalSpec.base_text: Exact unchanged base text; spec.text is exact selected BASE/enriched text. Existing program/profile/adapters/symbols/obligations/expected stay base-derived. Legacy base_text may default to text.
goal_context_build_fields.GoalSpec.readable_selection: bytes | None plus source-derived descriptor needed for selected rendering; never grants CHECKED until run_build replay audit.
goal_context_build_fields.Build.readable_support: dict | None canonical checked support descriptor required for certificate/IR/evidence/closure bindings, no volatile process telemetry. Includes selected_mode/status/selection ref/output manifest ref/support inventory and module-part hash/selected goal hash.
goal_context_build_fields.Build.readable_artifacts: dict[str, bytes], exact accepted output readable artifact set regenerated in this build. Existing modules/observation/proposition_hash/ir/axioms and separately owned defaulted process_evidence remain intact.

derive_and_run_contract: derive_goal(ctx) derives the unchanged base spec first, then if ctx has frozen selection deterministically reconstructs its selected text/metadata and validates static source/renderer/goal hashes. This is pure derivation, not kernel qualification. BASE remains byte-identical; CHECKED selected text is appendix to full base bytes.

run_build(tc,ctx,spec,with_proof=...) preserves current call signature. For frozen CHECKED selected specs it first admits/replays exact base with no candidate proof, then freshly compiles/replays exact selected enrichment and validates complete frozen descriptor; compile proof only against selected goal. No downgrade path. Legacy/BASE uses unchanged goal path.

Source preview qualification uses a separate try_readable_view after an admitted base build, returns selected GoalSpec/Build/info. An optional failure may fallback only at that explicit initial source selection step.

check_edge returns selected spec plus two fresh selected builds; outputs persists Build.readable_support/artifacts, source selected goal and exact support certificate/evidence refs. Existing callers of derive_goal then run_build therefore reproduce frozen selection rather than BASE-only execution.

All current return signatures remain backward-compatible; added dataclass fields are defaulted. The telemetry-owned Build.process_evidence/compile_process_evidence pipeline and diagnostic helpers are preserved and not overlapped.
candidate_files_contract: candidate_files keeps its existing signature. If info has selection bytes, add fixed selection metadata slot and declared diagnostic input slots/roles to proposal.artifacts and reproducible_slots, hash/preserve exact bytes and verify info candidate map matches selection.
With no selection metadata, emit the existing five-slot proposal, strictly legacy BASE. Source_slot/proof_slot stay vscore-source/vscore-proof; relation unchanged.
Never call optional qualification/reselection from candidate_files. Never trust supplied support source/module/theorem/status to establish correspondence.
agent_persistence_contract: For .3 first source checked preview explicitly sets select_readable=True. Retain exact selected goal plus info.readable_artifacts once under that source stage. Store selection hash/ref and bounded readable packet in checks/source.json while retaining root compile_process_evidence persistence.

Every initial/proposed proof preview passes identical selection bytes with select_readable=False. The prover receives selected generated_goal and readable_source_view; status never changes during that source search.

Every successful or exhausted source candidate return includes info.readable_candidate_artifacts along with source/relation/Proof.lean. A source candidate BASE legacy without metadata remains unchanged. No new task source/proof is generated by view support.
backend_integration_contract: vscore3.generate reads optional fixed selection file from explicit candidate, or takes identical bytes from returned agent files. It passes those bytes to proof-free preview with select_readable=False. Missing sidecar is legacy BASE, not an opportunity to select support.

It packages candidate_files from the resulting replayed info, requiring exact sidecar/candidate metadata preservation. A frozen run compares sidecar and diagnostic inputs as well as existing source/relation/proof; mutations require a new run.
Existing _materialize and link derive selected context/spec and call unchanged run_build signature, which now replays frozen support. No separate inferred mode from proof usage.

Closure loads selection through context, replays exact selected spec from freshly accepted contract, copies every Build.readable_artifacts file through outputs, adds readable_support comparison slot and requires all corresponding refs. No preview/stored goal module reuse.
closed_schema_note: Parent closed selection/view schemas remain normative plus minimal recipe OPTIONAL_UNAVAILABLE reason enum addition. Concrete API keys are transport fields, not authorization fields. If implementation minimizes artifact duplication, it must preserve these exact mode/hash/inventory semantics and independently verified refs; no silent API retry or fallback.
validation_addition: Mocked source preview -> repeated proof previews -> agent candidate return -> generate repackaging must preserve identical selection bytes, selected goal hash, mode and metadata inputs; force optional unavailable on a replay and verify CHECKED is blocking rather than reselected BASE. Real generic integration and two builds still required.
